item.name: marquee
item.summary: strip: Infinite marquee with inert duplicate, hover/focus pause, and WCAG pause button (dom, server-safe, <2.5 KB, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> ok)

useWhen: Logo clouds, customer testimonials, and partner strips
Continuous market tickers, tech badges, and announcement banners
Visual social proof ribbons requiring smooth continuous transit
avoidWhen: Critical action buttons or primary call-to-action links that users must click immediately
Dense paragraphs of essential reading material
Pages where multiple moving strips compete for visual attention

alternatives.name: scroll-reveal
alternatives.when: When cards or media should reveal progressively upon scrolling rather than auto-looping

tiers.0: Static horizontally scrollable row without CSS keyframe animation
tiers.1: CSS marquee running at conservative speed without extra rAF hooks
tiers.2: Standard CSS marquee with hover/focus pause listeners
tiers.3: Full CSS marquee with dynamic width calibration and accessible pause controls

reducedMotion.description: Animation ceases and track displays as a static, horizontally scrollable row.

input.touch: Touch-scrollable row under reduced motion or static tiers
input.keyboard: Tabbing into items pauses marquee; duplicate items are inert

a11y.notes: Duplicate copy is marked aria-hidden='true' and inert so screen readers and keyboard users encounter each element exactly once. Built-in pause button satisfies WCAG 2.2.2.

props.name: children
props.effect: Content elements repeated across scrolling strip.

props.name: speed
props.effect: Transit rate in pixels per second.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.effect: Freezes scroll transit while pointer hovers over strip.

props.name: pauseOnFocus
props.effect: Freezes scroll transit while any child element holds keyboard focus.

props.name: showPauseButton
props.effect: Renders accessible button allowing users to pause animation (WCAG 2.2.2).

props.name: className
props.effect: CSS classes applied to outer container.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on device capability tier.

mistakes: Do not remove the inert attribute from duplicate tracks or screen readers will double-read every item.
Do not hide the pause control if the marquee runs continuously for more than 5 seconds (WCAG 2.2.2).
verify: Verify screen reader encounters each badge/item exactly once.
Verify hovering or focusing an item pauses animation transit.
Verify reduced motion pauses marquee into a static scrollable row.
